note: The parked payload is deposited and redeemed through a data-access connector to the shared store

cite: EIP, Message Dispatcher: explicitly compared with Competing Consumers for parallel consumption
note: In-process dispatch vs multiple independent consumers on one channel

cite: EIP, Message Translator: same pattern; the architecture entry is its system-integration scale
note: Same-name-two-realms pair (identical id in both realms - see notes)

cite: Candea & Fox, 'Crash-Only Software' (HotOS 2003): argues for crash+recover as the only stop/start path, explicitly against maintaining separate clean-shutdown code
note: Cross-realm alternative: graceful two-phase shutdown vs designing so that crashing is the shutdown.

cite: Enterprise Integration Patterns (Hohpe & Woolf), Messaging Channels chapter: Dead Letter Channel is a channel the messaging system moves undeliverable messages to
note: A channel type in EIP's own taxonomy.

cite: Akka documentation (supervision and the error kernel): keep important state high in the actor hierarchy, delegate risky work to child actors that can fail and be restarted
note: The error kernel is articulated in terms of the supervision tree.

cite: Avizienis, The N-Version Approach to Fault-Tolerant Software: version outputs are adjudicated by a decision algorithm/voter
note: The voter is a defined part of NVP.

cite: Fowler, P of EAA catalog 'Notification': an object collecting errors from the domain layer, passed back across the service-layer boundary instead of throwing
note: Fowler describes Notification at the layer boundary.

cite: Randell, System Structure for Software Fault Tolerance (1975): on acceptance-test failure, state is restored to the recovery point before the alternate runs
note: Rollback to the recovery point is a defined step of the scheme.

cite: Site Reliability Engineering (Google), Handling Overload: per-client retry budgets (e.g. retries at most 10% of requests) bound the retry tactic's added load
note: The budget is a stated guard on retrying.

cite: AUTOSAR Watchdog Manager (WdgM) specification: alive, deadline and logical (program-flow) supervision results drive the hardware watchdog
note: Sequence monitoring is specified as a watchdog-manager function.
